svg.text: A Workshop & Accelerator for Constructing Reliable, Production-Grade Agentic Systems
9 predefined intents. The model may choose exactly one.
Each intent authorizes a fixed set of agents. The model
may never reach for an agent outside that set.
Intent is the last unstructured moment; every hop after
it is a validated Pydantic object.
The planner proposes; code checks 1–8 steps and
Only SELECT / WITH reach the database; writes are
not allowed — enforced outside the model's reach.
The model reasons and writes the answer.
Routing, validation, and security are all code.
Helpful redirect to asset health & restoration.
Soft apology; detail tucked into artifacts["error"].
Plan invalid — empty, > 8 steps, or off the allow-list.
The outcome lives in the final / error stream event,
never in the status code. No path throws a 500.
Two feeds in: Execution Trace panel + the answer.
Routes the request to the chosen reasoning strategy
Orchestrator — Deterministic outer pipeline wrapping probabilistic, model-based operations
classify → reason → compose. Owns no domain logic.
Injected: IReasoning (ReAct or Plan-&-Execute reasoning components).
Every path out emits a terminal 'final' or 'error' event.
Invokes an SLM model call to classify
Application injects reasoning component at start-up:
REASONING STRATEGIES — ONE RUNS PER REQUEST
PLAN-AND-EXECUTE — PLAN ONCE, VALIDATE, RUN IN ORDER
ReAct — DECIDE · ACT · OBSERVE, ONE AGENT AT A TIME
MCP call — a natural-language question as payload

g.text: DATA LEG — HOW ANY DATA AGENT REACHES POSTGRES
One fresh session per call. Streamable HTTP.
SELECT / WITH only · single statement · LIMIT n
Fast-fail convenience — NOT the security boundary.
This + the read-only grant is the real security boundary.
Enforced outside any process the model can influence.
rows → parsed to list[dict] → back up as AgentResult

Model calls: #1 classify intent · #2 plan once (Plan-&-Execute) or decide per step (ReAct) · #3 NL2SQL · #4 narrate answer. Between them: fixed intent taxonomy, allow-list, 1–8 step validation, statement checks, write-disabled grant — all code.
